title: Register-instruction part of a program
statement: Let $A$ be a memory-addressing program and let $\beta$ be a Boolean value. The register-instruction part assigns to each label its register instruction when $A$ assigns one there; at labels where $A$ assigns any other instruction, it assigns a halt instruction returning $\beta$.
